name: Permanent Residence Certificate -- Investment Routes

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a home investment of $300,000 to $1,000,000 depending on location, plus a Governor's undertaking. No work permission is granted with this route.
Requires a business investment of $750,000 to $1,500,000, with at least 60% of employees being non-work-permit (i.e. Islander/PRC) holders. Work permission is limited to the applicant's own business.
Requires a minimum $1,000,000 contribution to an approved public sector project.
Requires a minimum $1,000,000 invested in a home or business, without requiring a Governor's undertaking.

evidence_required.document: Certified passport photos, birth certificate, government ID
Proof of investment (property deed, business registration, or project contribution records)
Character references and police certificate (within 6 months)
Route fee: $25,000 plus a $1,500 undertaking fee (home investment, business investment, public sector project); $25,000 with no undertaking fee (investment without undertaking)

sources.title: Government of the Turks and Caicos Islands -- Permanent Residence Certificate: four investment-based routes (home, business, public sector project, investment without undertaking), fee schedule

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of the Turks and Caicos Islands' initial build. Four investment OR-groups from the same PRC page as the other three tc_prc_*.json files. work_rights is 'restricted' since the home-investment ground grants NO work permission at all, and the business-investment ground grants work permission only in the applicant's own business -- not a general right to work for any employer, distinguishing this PRC route materially from the residence/family/ancestry PRC grounds (all full work rights). This is the most expensive tier of PRC on the fee schedule ($25,000 plus, in three of four sub-grounds, a further $1,500 Governor's-undertaking fee) -- notably higher than the $10,000 work-permit-residence route or the $5,000 family/ancestry routes.
